business_summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited manufactures and distributes copper products in India. The company offers copper bus bars, wires and rods, foils and sheets, nuggets, tubes and pipes, paper insulated copper conductors, enameled strips and wires, continuous transpose conductors, and yoke assembly and solenoid switch products. It also provides solar flat plate collectors, solar fins, field coils and armature pins, and solar interconnect wires. In addition, the company operates 9 MW of wind power capacity. It serves automotive, switchgear, transformer, and other electrical industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Bhagyanagar Metals Ltd. and changed its name to Bhagyanagar India Limited in September 2006. Bhagyanagar India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
